evidence.observation: H701 temperature reads 437.4 °C, markedly higher than H702 at 69.8 °C and the reboiler at 69.9 °C.
The large discrepancy persists: T701=439.5 °C, T702=70.3 °C, T703=70.4 °C; possible local overheating or temperature-measurement fault, not distinguished by these readings.
Other heaters remain at 70.0 °C and column temperatures range from 63.3 to 68.8 °C, without a corresponding large thermal excursion.
Distillate, reflux, and cooling-water flows remain present at 0.1, 0.2, and 6.8 respectively; no composition measurement has been supplied.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and allowable heater temperature, heater power/readback, and an independent H701 temperature measurement are needed to distinguish actual overheating from sensor/calibration failure. Pressure instruments are not installed. Composition analysis and the separation target are required to assess separation.
